verdict.rationale: Postman CLI can run entire collections (many requests) in one command with reporting and CI/CD integration, and the Postman API allows programmatic, scriptable management of many Postman assets at once, which supports bulk automation workflows. However, there's no explicit documentation of dedicated 'bulk edit' or batch-processing tools (e.g., bulk update/delete across items) beyond running/collections and API-driven scripting. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-edit/batch UI or CLI functionality across large sets of unrelated items, independent hands-on confirmation of bulk operation performance at scale.
